casePolicy: Keep the existing sixteen cases, supplied leaves, fixtures, order, resource limits and raw comparison unchanged.

visitPolicy.completion: Compare actual completion boolean on every paired invocation, including the terminal invocation. A differing boolean, missing invocation or extra invocation fails the owned projection. Preserve the original stop-on-completion or declared-cap policy.
visitPolicy.activeState: Compare owned after-state only when both actual completion booleans are false. Do not compare residual after-state as owned acceptance when either body reports completion.
visitPolicy.declaredCap: A case reaching its unchanged cap with false on both sides is a bounded partial observation, not lifecycle completion.
visitPolicy.rawState: Retain every full before/after record, event, original comparison field and raw difference at all boundaries, including terminal invocations. Never relabel the original whole-record comparison passed on an owned-only match.

activeAfterBits.meaning: Ranged changed-target entry pending bit; consumed by the original ranged entry before readiness/phase selection.

assignmentPolicy: Compare the entire assignment word during active visits, not just a mask. Original ranged entry/phase uses 0x10 and 0x200; the real upper setter clears 0x80. Unrelated bits must remain preserved for the fixed input.

normalizations.trackedProjectile: Native actor +0x72 versus port p.stateObject; preserve raw native +0x87 and port p.target separately.
normalizations.cooldown: Native byte versus round(Unit.cooldown * TURNS_PER_SECOND), using the unchanged twelve-turn fixture normalization.

invariantGuards: The sixteen normalized initial comparison records must still match; no fixture tuning to make the candidate pass.
The paired launch and projectile attribution remain unchanged; no extra projectile creation during the active phase.
Original code/setter execution and the baseline records remain immutable.
diagnosticOnly: All facing fields: angle, heading, turnAngle, turnY and Unit.heading.
All flags2 bits except the explicitly owned 0x40000000 entry bit.
State, substate, commandStatus, commandAux, commandPhase, speed, workTarget and caller-owned queue/state transitions.
All residual after-state on a completion invocation, including source/draw/reset/hold/timer/assignment/projectile fields.
All remaining full-record fields and raw differences already retained by the baseline probe.
claimsAllowed: The scoped active selector/reset/hold/timer/assignment behavior and body-completion visit boundary match for the fixed sixteen synthetic cases.
claimsExcluded: Whole-command, outer-caller, orientation, elapsed gameplay, animation-clock, native-scene, ordinary person-target or global parity equivalence.
